verdict.rationale: Poke documents an official npm-distributed CLI (`npx poke@latest`) with `login`, `tunnel`, `mcp add`, and a `--recipe` flag that returns a recipe link and QR code in the terminal. Its documented scope is narrow, limited to MCP server and recipe developer workflows rather than general assistant use from the terminal. missing for 10: a dedicated CLI reference documenting all commands, CLI-based messaging or task execution (the documented messaging path is the HTTP API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: npx poke@latest tunnel http://localhost:3000/mcp -n "Local Dev MCP"
npx poke@latest mcp add https://mcp.example.com/sse -n "My Server"
With --recipe, the CLI creates a connection and returns a recipe link and QR code in the terminal.
